payload.claim: The module docstring now claims 'every command's `Ledger` is constructed with a `RoutedRecord`', but `_fold` (saffron/cli.py:2186) builds its destination ledger as `Ledger(Path(args.into))` with no `record=` argument at all, and `migrate`/`serve` build no shared `Ledger` through this path either. CLAUDE.md's parallel edit correctly says 'every command's shared `Ledger` carries one', but this docstring drops the 'shared' qualifier and so overclaims something the `fold` command's own code (unchanged by this diff) contradicts.
